name: General Creator / Safe Brand Standards
customRules: Avoid absolute claims regarding health or monetary returns

regexRules.name: Guaranteed Return Claim
regexRules.reason: Explicitly guarantees financial returns, which violates creator advertising standards.
regexRules.suggestedAction: Qualify statements to discuss potential or past observations rather than guarantees.

name: Health & Wellness Compliance
customRules: Must include disclaimer if discussing health supplements

regexRules.name: FDA Approval Claim
regexRules.reason: Claiming FDA approval on dietary supplements or content is prohibited.
regexRules.suggestedAction: State that product is produced in an inspected facility without claiming FDA product approval.

regexRules.name: Medical Treatment Claim
regexRules.reason: Medical treatment claims require qualified substantiation.
regexRules.suggestedAction: Use permitted phrasing such as "supports overall vitality" or "maintains healthy cellular function".

regexRules.name: Exploitation Instructions
regexRules.reason: Content appears to describe unauthorized access or illegal bypass mechanisms.
regexRules.suggestedAction: Emphasize defensive cybersecurity concepts rather than exploit methods.

regexRules.name: FDA Approved Claim
regexRules.reason: Claiming FDA approval is strictly prohibited for supplements.
